chapter: From Pittsburgh to Maxine Sullivan: management and style
title: A Louisville concert and vaudeville dates
summary: A one-off jazz concert in Louisville; she was mostly doing concerts and vaudeville.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well, when was it, at the end of 1939, this is something I saw in Albert McCarthy's book called "Big Band Jazz", and it says there on page 149 that you worked out in Louisville, that's Louisville, Kentucky with the Harlan Leonard Band towards the end of 1939.
Yeah, I went down to Louieville Kentucky to do a concert, a jazz concert.
Just one performance. I went down there. It was sponsored by the local newspapers and the local NAACP, and they had quite a show. They had Harlan Leonard Band, and some local acts.
Okay, I guess you were on the road a lot at that time?
Yeah, I was doing concerts and mostly vaudeville.
